_readme: AIF / PMS holdings, one file per provider. Copy this to <provider-slug>.json
(e.g. marcellus-ccp.json) and fill it from the provider's monthly/quarterly
fact sheet. Files whose name starts with '_' are ignored (this template).
Only ISIN + a label is required per holding; percent/value/shares are optional
(fact sheets usually give % of portfolio). ISIN is the join key (Rule 4): use
the real INE... ISIN, never the name, as the key. Rows without a valid INE ISIN
'disclosure': 'partial' means only the top holdings are shown (the norm for
AIF/PMS). We treat this data as ENTRY-ONLY — a name leaving the list is NEVER
read as a sell. List each month you have a fact sheet for; months can be
monthly or quarterly, whatever the provider publishes.
name: Example Capital — Flagship PMS
